title: Bug 643235: Payment Reconciliation Journal does not round imported bank fee amounts
summary: Payment reconciliation journal posting now rounds imported bank fee amounts according to the posting currency's amount rounding precision to prevent posting failures.
key_points: Bank fee amounts are rounded before being copied to the general journal
Rounding follows the posting currency's configured precision rules
Fixes posting failures when imported amounts don't match the expected rounding precision
Test coverage added for local currency, foreign currency, and edge cases
quote: Round payment reconciliation amounts according to the posting currency's amount rounding precision before posting.
